delivery_notes_destination.name: delivery_notes_destination
delivery_notes_destination.value: ("logistics"."delivery_notes"."kind" = 'SALE') = ("logistics"."delivery_notes"."customer_id" is not null) and ("logistics"."delivery_notes"."kind" = 'TRANSFER') = ("logistics"."delivery_notes"."destination_branch_id" is not null)

store_points_source.name: store_points_source
store_points_source.value: "logistics"."store_points"."source" in ('VISIT', 'OFFICE') and ("logistics"."store_points"."source" = 'VISIT') = ("logistics"."store_points"."photo_file_id" is not null and "logistics"."store_points"."trip_id" is not null)

store_points_kind.name: store_points_kind
store_points_kind.value: "logistics"."store_points"."kind" in ('NEW', 'CORRECTION') and ("logistics"."store_points"."kind" = 'NEW' or "logistics"."store_points"."reason" is not null)

store_points_decided.name: store_points_decided
store_points_decided.value: ("logistics"."store_points"."status" = 'PENDING') = ("logistics"."store_points"."decided_at" is null) and ("logistics"."store_points"."status" = 'REJECTED') = ("logistics"."store_points"."reject_reason" is not null)

trip_end_reports_fuel.name: trip_end_reports_fuel
trip_end_reports_fuel.value: "logistics"."trip_end_reports"."needs_fuel" = ("logistics"."trip_end_reports"."fuel_estimate" is not null) and ("logistics"."trip_end_reports"."fuel_estimate" is null or "logistics"."trip_end_reports"."fuel_estimate" > 0)

trip_end_reports_fuel_close.name: trip_end_reports_fuel_close
trip_end_reports_fuel_close.value: ("logistics"."trip_end_reports"."fuel_closed_at" is null) = ("logistics"."trip_end_reports"."fuel_close_kind" is null) and ("logistics"."trip_end_reports"."fuel_closed_at" is null or "logistics"."trip_end_reports"."needs_fuel")

trip_pickups_done.name: trip_pickups_done
trip_pickups_done.value: ("logistics"."trip_pickups"."status" = 'DONE') = ("logistics"."trip_pickups"."done_at" is not null and "logistics"."trip_pickups"."photo_file_id" is not null)

trip_shopping_done.name: trip_shopping_done
trip_shopping_done.value: ("logistics"."trip_shopping"."status" = 'DONE') = ("logistics"."trip_shopping"."done_at" is not null and "logistics"."trip_shopping"."receipt_photo_file_id" is not null)

trip_shopping_dropped.name: trip_shopping_dropped
trip_shopping_dropped.value: ("logistics"."trip_shopping"."status" = 'DROPPED') = ("logistics"."trip_shopping"."dropped_at" is not null and "logistics"."trip_shopping"."drop_reason" is not null)

trip_wages_once.name: trip_wages_once
trip_wages_once.where: "logistics"."trip_wages"."trip_id" is not null and "logistics"."trip_wages"."cancelled_at" is null

trips_departed.name: trips_departed
trips_departed.value: ("logistics"."trips"."status" in ('RUNNING', 'DONE')) = ("logistics"."trips"."departed_at" is not null and "logistics"."trips"."trip_date" is not null and "logistics"."trips"."crew_photo_file_id" is not null)

trips_cancelled.name: trips_cancelled
trips_cancelled.value: ("logistics"."trips"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("logistics"."trips"."cancelled_at" is not null and "logistics"."trips"."cancel_reason" is not null)

trips_heading_home.name: trips_heading_home
trips_heading_home.value: ("logistics"."trips"."heading_home_at" is null) = ("logistics"."trips"."empty_bed_photo_file_id" is null) and ("logistics"."trips"."heading_home_at" is null or "logistics"."trips"."status" in ('RUNNING', 'DONE'))

visit_payments_amounts.name: visit_payments_amounts
visit_payments_amounts.value:
"logistics"."visit_payments"."bill_amount" >= 0 and "logistics"."visit_payments"."received_amount" >= 0 and (
      ("logistics"."visit_payments"."method" = 'NONE' and "logistics"."visit_payments"."bill_amount" = 0 and "logistics"."visit_payments"."received_amount" = 0)
      or ("logistics"."visit_payments"."method" in ('CASH', 'TRANSFER') and "logistics"."visit_payments"."bill_amount" > 0 and "logistics"."visit_payments"."received_amount" = "logistics"."visit_payments"."bill_amount")
      or ("logistics"."visit_payments"."method" = 'PARTIAL' and "logistics"."visit_payments"."received_amount" > 0 and "logistics"."visit_payments"."received_amount" < "logistics"."visit_payments"."bill_amount")
      or ("logistics"."visit_payments"."method" = 'TEMPO' and "logistics"."visit_payments"."bill_amount" > 0 and "logistics"."visit_payments"."received_amount" = 0))

visit_reports_kind.name: visit_reports_kind
visit_reports_kind.value: "logistics"."visit_reports"."kind" in ('WRONG_ITEM', 'SHORT', 'DAMAGED', 'RETURN', 'OTHER') and ("logistics"."visit_reports"."kind" <> 'OTHER' or "logistics"."visit_reports"."note" is not null)

visit_reports_closed.name: visit_reports_closed
visit_reports_closed.value: ("logistics"."visit_reports"."closed_at" is null) = ("logistics"."visit_reports"."close_note" is null) and ("logistics"."visit_reports"."closed_at" is null) = ("logistics"."visit_reports"."closed_by_account_id" is null)
